body.secretariat: Here you find the agenda, the documents and the amendments of each assembly. You organise them: you create assemblies, check what members submit and publish it.
body.mesa: Here you find the agenda, the documents and the amendments of each assembly. You run the session: speaking turns, headcounts and votes.
body.cea: Here you find the agenda, the documents and the amendments of each assembly. You submit documents and amendments for your CEA office.
body.cas: Here are the agenda, the documents and the amendments of each assembly. You present documents and amendments on behalf of the Sectoral Affairs Committee (CAS). There is only one thing you cannot present: an internal motion. You can still amend one.
body.asociado: Here you find the agenda, the documents and the amendments of each assembly. You submit documents and amendments for your council.
body.sectorial: Here you find the agenda, the documents and the amendments of each assembly. You submit documents and amendments for your sectorial. The one thing you cannot submit is an internal motion. You can still amend one.
body.guest: Here you find the agenda, the documents and the amendments of each assembly. You can read everything, but you cannot submit or change anything.

manage.body: What members submit reaches you in "Validation", inside each assembly. There you check it and publish it. The items of the assembly are ordered in "Agenda".

moderate.title: How to run the session
moderate.body: Open the assembly and go to "Session". There you keep the speaking turns, the headcounts and the votes.

read.title: How to read the documents
read.body: Open the assembly and go to "Agenda" or "Documents". Press a document to read all of it.
